# 2026 Week 8 fixture (story format tests)

`context.json` is the Week 8 sources snapshot (recorded 2026-11-05) with three changes: `d1.chat` is replaced by three synthetic
lines (no owner chat is stored here), `archive` is the league archive's weekly scores for weeks 1-8 of 2011-2025
(`ups_center_sources.archive_history`; league scores, no personal data), and `eliasReport` / `scoresPublished` are the committed
`site/wire/data/elias_2026_wk08.json` and the frozen scores. The pack is the committed `site/wire/packs/2026/2026-wk08-recap.pack.json`.
